What you really want is the guy in the middle of the pack, who isnt just looking to wet his dick, but is looking to find someone they want to spend a goodly amount of time around. You want someone who wants to do the things you like, so show them you doing what you like. Guys are visual, we skim pictures before we even see the text, just do make sure to take the best possible looking image of yourself. Its not lying, just selling yourself. DO have text though, stuff that is not generic, there are lots of fake profiles on the internet meant to get guys to buy into a cam model session or something shady. Definitely have more than face shots, that is code for 'I am fat'

**Dont spill the beans on everything before you meet, ** meeting dates through the internet is a progression. The texting is just about making sure this person isnt super crazy, the goal is to move on to meeting up pretty quickly. You are not putting it all out on the table to make sure you dont have deal breakers, just chattering away, this small talk sucks for both parties, but just relax into it.
